sandboxBadge: PayPal sandbox · no real money moves
title: Pick a plan, pay once
intro: Feedloop is a support agent that settles payments with PayPal. Buy a plan below with a PayPal sandbox buyer account, then ask the chat in the corner about your payment — for example, a refund.
notSetUp: The demo shop is not set up yet. Run npm run db:seed-demo to add the demo bot and its products.
footnote: Payments run in the PayPal sandbox during the PayPal AI Hackathon. Prices are placeholders and no real money moves.

captured.title: Payment received
captured.body: Thank you! Your plan is paid.

approved.title: Payment processing
approved.body: PayPal is still processing this payment. This page updates when it completes.

created.title: Waiting for PayPal
created.body: This order has not been approved on PayPal yet. This page updates on its own.

failed.title: Payment declined
failed.body: PayPal declined the payment. Nothing was charged.

receipt.questions: Questions about this payment? Open the chat in the corner and include your PayPal order ID and the email you paid with.
